stem: How does the windy setting contribute to the poem?

options.label: A
options.text: The windy setting causes the mother squirrel to become afraid of storms.

options.label: B
options.text: The windy setting makes a squirrel family leave the woods.

options.label: C
options.text: The windy setting adds a feeling of mystery to the plot.

options.label: D
options.text: The windy setting causes a problem the mother squirrel must solve.
